title: materials.draft.v2
description: Plain-string draft slots from the Materials v3 draft stage: a statement, one string per featured bullet keyed by claim id, earlier lines, and five role-typed letter beats (hook, companyInsight, proof1, proof2, ask; K4). v1 drafts (thesis, analyticsProof, aiOpsProof, nextStep) stay readable through materials-draft.v1.schema.json. No markup in any field; emphasis is the metric tagger's job.

hook.description: Opening sentence: names the company and one specific fact about it.

companyInsight.description: What the company needs from this role, in the posting's own nouns.

proof1.description: Biggest-number proof answering one named job responsibility.

proof2.description: Second proof answering a different responsibility.
